newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Breweries, bank pull down Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Breweries, bank pull down Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: Falling shares on breweries and bank stocks dragged down the Stock Exchange of Mauritius (SEM) index, Semdex, marginally by O.38 points to 379.22, bourse officials said on Friday.
Turnover rose to 9.86 million rupees on 351,310 shares from 8.82 million rupees on 321,144 shares on last Wednesday.
The Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) fell 50 cents to 88.50 rupees on 5,250 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) climbed 10 cents to 11.50 rupees on 63,400 shares.
"After nine consecutive trading sessions with a share price unchanged at 89.00 rupees, the MCB fell 50 cents this morning," one broker said.
In the industrial sector, Mauritius Breweries Limited (MBL) was 4.00 rupees lower to 145.00 rupees on 5,300 shares and United Basalt Products (UBP) fell 50 cents to 33.40 rupees on 2,550 shares.

Hotel based New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) was unchanged to 36.30 rupees on 154,913 shares, Sun Resorts was stable at 48.80 rupees on 200 shares and Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) remained to 47.20 rupees on 2,730 shares.
"Today foreign investors showed buying interest on NMH shares," a broker said.
Conglomerate Rogers gained 50 cents to 98.50 rupees on 2,164 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) was unchanged at 15.50 rupees on 12,780 shares.

Investment company Fincorp, was stable at 70.00 rupees on 5,404 shares while National Investment Trust (NIT) too, was unchanged at 10.90 rupees on 25,600 shares. Policy remained at 4.20 rupees on 21,883 shares.
In the sugar sector, Harel Freres was stable at 57.00 rupees on 50 shares while Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) eased 30 cents to 39.60.
National carrier Air Mauritius fell 10 cents to 39.90 rupees on 220 shares.
